image_prompt.text: The arena floor split into four large, even, easily identifiable quadrant platforms — one red, one green, one blue, one yellow — arranged in a square, clean and low-poly
The central platform all four coloured quadrants connect to, where players gather before and between rounds, sized for the full server without bottlenecking at the four connections
The four coloured platforms and the central platform they connect to, all floating separately in open air with nothing beneath them, crossed only by the central link

notes: would have asked: Sounds like a single continuous play space rather than a lobby-plus-stage: four large colour-coded quadrant platforms — red, green, blue, yellow — set in a square, all joined by one central gathering platform, the whole thing floating in open air in a clean low-poly style. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?
would have asked: the only Core feature not already in this is a leaderboard wall — worth a prominent panel on the central platform showing scores between rounds?
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?

Prompt self-describes as a 'mini-game', but the Minigame preset was not taken: its space-staged shape (lobby fully separated from the match area, P4) is contradicted by a single floating arena with no lobby, and three of its four options (lobby-to-stage teleporters, leaderboard wall, spectator area) are unmentioned. Quiz was taken instead because what it builds — a continuous play space with a symmetric colour-coded tile grid and a central gathering area — is exactly the described geometry. Shape and both preset options kept unchanged; nothing substituted.
Genre note applied: the isolated stage is conditional, not structural — forcing space-staged here would cost P4 for nothing, so the arena is built as one continuous space.

CHECK comes from island-cluster (separate masses with open air between them). It should clear: the five platforms are coplanar and connected by the central platform, so the play volume does not self-occlude — this is not layered floating islands.
Art direction ('colorful', 'simple, clean, low-poly') is carried inside the image_prompt texts rather than as a separate pick; it is a property of the listed geometry, not a feature to place.
